content:
The dominant peak at 998 cm⁻¹ is the most diagnostic feature here. This is the well-known ring-breathing mode of monosubstituted benzene, characteristically strong and sharp in Raman. Combined with the aromatic C-H stretch at 3073 cm⁻¹, the C=C ring stretches at 1600 and 1572 cm⁻¹, and aliphatic C-H stretches at 2938 and 2879 cm⁻¹ (consistent with an ethyl group), this pattern points strongly to ethylbenzene (CCc1ccccc1, candidate 4) or ethoxybenzene (CCOc1ccccc1, candidate 5).

The peak at 670 cm⁻¹ is notable — ethylbenzene has a known out-of-plane ring deformation near 620–700 cm⁻¹. The 1071 and 1204 cm⁻¹ peaks correspond well to in-plane C-H deformation modes of a monosubstituted benzene ring. The 847 cm⁻¹ peak fits the out-of-plane C-H wag of the ring. The 1458 cm⁻¹ band is consistent with CH₂/CH₃ deformation of the ethyl chain.

Distinguishing candidate 4 (CCc1ccccc1, ethylbenzene) from candidate 5 (CCOc1ccccc1, ethoxybenzene): ethoxybenzene would show a C-O-C stretch prominently around 1040–1050 cm⁻¹, and its ring breathing mode shifts slightly. The 1071 cm⁻¹ peak could fit either, but the overall pattern — strong 998 cm⁻¹ ring breath, simple aliphatic C-H region with two close peaks at 2879/2938, and no obvious strong ether C-O-C signature dominating the 1000–1100 cm⁻¹ region — aligns better with ethylbenzene. Ethylbenzene's Raman spectrum is well documented with peaks at ~998, ~1002 (ring breath), ~1030, ~1072, ~1156, ~1206, ~1378, ~1451, ~1494, ~1604 cm⁻¹ and aromatic C-H near 3062 cm⁻¹, matching the observed pattern closely.

SELECTED_INDEX: 4
CONFIDENCE: 0.78
EXPLANATION: The strong peak at 998 cm⁻¹ is the hallmark monosubstituted benzene ring-breathing mode; aromatic C-H stretch at 3073 cm⁻¹, ring C=C stretches at 1600 and 1572 cm⁻¹, in-plane C-H deformations at 1204 and 1167 cm⁻¹, and aliphatic C-H stretches at 2938/2879 cm⁻¹ from the ethyl group all match ethylbenzene (CCc1ccccc1). The 670 cm⁻¹ ring deformation and 1458 cm⁻¹ CH₂ scissors are also consistent. Candidate 5 (ethoxybenzene) would show a more prominent ether C-O-C stretch near 1040–1050 cm⁻¹ as a dominant feature, which is not clearly distinct here.
